confirm.okDescription: Thank you for confirming {email}. Letters from the atelier will arrive from time to time, never often.
confirm.alreadyDescription: {email} is already on the list, so there is nothing more to do.
confirm.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
confirm.invalidDescription: The link may have been used already or replaced by a newer one. Subscribe again from the home page and we will send a fresh link.

unsubscribe.okDescription: {email} will receive no further letters. You are welcome back whenever you like.
unsubscribe.alreadyDescription: {email} had already left the list, so nothing changed.
unsubscribe.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
unsubscribe.invalidDescription: We could not match this link to a subscription. If you keep receiving letters, reply to one and we will remove you by hand.
